contact_vis = False

tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames

vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain

patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 3.5)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1
    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# 1. Initialize the Chrono engine and create the physical system
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('path/to/data')  # Set the correct data path if needed
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# 2. Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
application = irr.ChIrrApp(system, 'CityBus Simulation', irr.dimension2du(1024, 768))
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalCamera(irr.vector3df(0, 10, -20))
application.AddTypicalLights()

# 3. Create the terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
terrain.SetTexture(vehicle.GetDataFile('terrain/textures/tile4.jpg'))
terrain.Initialize()

# 4. Create the CityBus vehicle
# Define initial position and orientation
initial_pos = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0)
initial_rot = chrono.Q_from_AngZ(0)

# Instantiate the vehicle with specified parameters
citybus = veh.CityBus(system)
citybus.SetPos(initial_pos)
citybus.SetRot(initial_rot)

# Set tire model to a detailed tire model (e.g., RigidTire)
for tire in citybus.GetTireList():
    tire.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType.RIGID)
    # Optional: set tire visualization type
    tire.SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)

# 5. Set visualization types for vehicle parts
# For example, mesh visualization for the chassis
citybus.GetChassisBody().GetVisualShape(0).SetMeshFilename(vehicle.GetDataFile('vehicle/CityBus/CityBus_mesh.obj'))
# Primitive visualization for other parts if needed
# (Assuming the default visualization is acceptable for other parts)

# 6. Create the driver system for interactive control
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(application)
driver.Initialize()
driver.SetInputMode(veh.ChIrrGuiDriver.InputMode.IDEAL)

# 7. Set up the simulation parameters
application.SetStepManage(true)
application.SetTimestep(1.0 / 50)  # 50 FPS

# 8. Set camera to follow the vehicle
application.GetSceneManager().AddCameraSceneNode(irr.SCameraSceneNode(
    application.GetSceneManager().GetRootSceneNode(),
    irr.SVector3(0, 5, -15),
    irr.SVector3(0, 2, 0),
    1000
))
# Alternatively, update camera position each frame to follow the vehicle

# 9. Main simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    # Begin scene rendering
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()

    # Update driver inputs
    driver.ReadInputs()

    # Apply driver controls to the vehicle
    citybus.SetSteeringAngle(driver.GetSteering() * 0.5)  # scale steering
    citybus.SetThrottle(driver.GetThrottle() * 1.0)
    citybus.SetBraking(driver.GetBrake() * 1.0)

    # Synchronize the vehicle
    citybus.Synchronize(chrono.ChTimeStep(1.0 / 50))
    system.DoStepDynamics(chrono.ChTimeStep(1.0 / 50))

    # Update camera to follow the vehicle
    vehicle_pos = citybus.GetChassisBody().GetPos()
    camera_pos = vehicle_pos + chrono.ChVectorD(0, 5, -15)
    application.GetSceneManager().GetActiveCameraSceneNode().setPosition(
        irr.SVector3(camera_pos.x, camera_pos.y + 2, camera_pos.z)
    )
    application.GetSceneManager().GetActiveCameraSceneNode().setTarget(
        irr.SVector3(vehicle_pos.x, vehicle_pos.y + 1, vehicle_pos.z)
    )

    # End scene rendering
    application.EndScene()

# End of script
```
